articles.summary: Adani Green reported a loss of ₹724 crore in H1 FY27 EBITDA due to transmission delays and curtailment at its Khavda project. The company expects improvements in the second half of the year.
articles.explain: EBITDA is a measure of a company's operating performance. 'Curtailment' in renewable energy refers to the loss of potential power generation because the grid is not equipped to handle the surge, leading to revenue loss for the producer.

story.title: Adani Green Financial Performance
story.so_far: Adani Green is a major renewable energy provider. Curtailment occurs when electricity producers are forced to limit their output because the power grid cannot transport or absorb all the energy being generated at that moment.

timeline.text: Operational setbacks in transmission have negatively impacted Adani Green's earnings for the first half of the fiscal year.

story.title: eMudhra Security Incident

articles.title: Women account for 44% of India’s inland fishers, says report
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: A new report reveals that women make up 44% of India’s inland fishers, though much of their work remains unrecognized in official statistics.
articles.explain: Undercounting occurs when specific workers, especially those performing unpaid or post-harvest tasks (like processing or marketing), are excluded from official government censuses or economic datasets.

story.title: Gender Representation in Inland Fishing
story.so_far: Inland fishing involves harvesting fish from freshwater sources like rivers and lakes. While essential to local food security and rural livelihoods, the industry has historically focused on the activities of male fishers in policy-making and data collection.

timeline.text: New data sheds light on the significant, yet often ignored, role of women in India's fishing sector.
timeline.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New

articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: J&K Bank reported a 10.6% increase in its Q2 net profit, reaching ₹546 crore, driven by strong earnings and improved asset quality.
articles.explain: Asset quality refers to the health of a bank's loan portfolio. If asset quality is 'improving,' it means fewer borrowers are defaulting on their loans, which allows the bank to increase its profit margins.

story.title: J&K Bank Quarterly Results
story.so_far: J&K Bank operates as a public sector bank in India. Quarterly results provide a snapshot of a bank's financial health, specifically focusing on its net profit—the actual money earned after all expenses and provisions for bad loans are deducted.

timeline.text: The bank saw a double-digit rise in profits for the second quarter compared to the previous year.
